papers.title: 2024年12月 · 第一套
papers.note: 听力部分卷面无作答痕迹，未计入

questions.brief: unique in this regard 搭配成立

questions.stem: And Morrison was not unique in this regard. Numerous writers produce masterpieces well into their 70s and beyond. Such <u>27</u> accomplishments highlight an important point.
questions.zh: 不止莫里森一个人如此。许多作家到七十多岁甚至更晚才写出杰作。这类 ______ 成就凸显了一个重要观点。
questions.why: 空格在 Such ____ accomplishments，accomplishments 是复数名词，前面必须是形容词。undermined 是过去分词，作定语表被动"被削弱的"，和"成就"语义互斥。再看上下文：authors、novel、writers、masterpieces——全段都在讲写小说，所以是 literary（文学的）。
questions.you: 你填的 M（undermined）三处不合：词性勉强、语义与成就互斥、全文没有"削弱"的语境。这类 -ed 分词是词库里的伪装形容词。
questions.fix: 凡 Such / the / a + ____ + 名词，空格 90% 是形容词。先把词库里的形容词圈出来，再逐一代入。

questions.stem: Our capacity to speak, write and learn new vocabulary does not seem to <u>28</u> with age.
questions.zh: 我们说话、写作和学习新词汇的能力，似乎并不会随年龄 ______。
questions.why: 硬语法：does not seem to ____，to 后只能是动词原形，unique 连入场资格都没有。语义：后接 with age，需要"变化类不及物动词"，deteriorate with age＝随年龄退化；下一句 eyesight may dim and our recall may weaken 正好在说别的能力在衰退，构成对照。
questions.you: unique 是形容词，不能作谓语、不能跟 with age。这说明当时用的是"读起来像不像"，而不是"这个位置允许什么词性"。
questions.fix: 先给 10 个空标词性槽位（to+原形 / 介词+n. / 限定词+adj. / 主+谓），标完再动笔。

questions.stem: But, by comparison, our ability to produce and to <u>29</u> language is well preserved into older adulthood.
questions.zh: 但相比之下，我们产出和理解语言的能力，直到成年后期都保存得很好。
questions.why: to produce and to ____ language 两个不定式并列、共用宾语 language，空格与 produce（产出）构成语义互补——一个输出、一个输入，comprehend（理解）正好补上语言能力的另一半。反面验证：后半句 is well preserved 是正面评价，填 deteriorate 就变成"产出和退化语言的能力被完好保存"，自相矛盾。
questions.you: deteriorate 语法合格，是纯语义错：你抓住了上一句"能力不随年龄退化"里的"退化"，却没注意本句已经翻到"保存良好"的正面立场。
questions.fix: 填完把整句读一遍，只问一句：这句和上一句同向还是反向？选词填空约三成错题属于"词性对、方向反"。

questions.brief: a journey that we begin as infants，定语从句判断准确
actually 修饰 improve，与 contrary to… 的转折逻辑一致
a sample of 固定搭配
approximately 修饰数字 16,000
performed better than，主谓结构成立

questions.stem: Thus, language seems to be a skill that, contrary to what many might <u>35</u>, does not weaken with age.
questions.zh: 因此，语言似乎是一种技能，与很多人可能以为的相反，它并不会随年龄衰退。
questions.why: 语法：what many might ____ 是宾语从句，might 后必须动词原形；equivalent 是形容词兼名词，放进去不成句。语义：contrary to what many might assume＝"与很多人的想当然相反"，是四级议论文里的高频套语，与后面 does not weaken with age 形成"常识 vs 事实"的对撞。
questions.you: 和 28 题同一个病：没先看情态动词后面的词性槽位。equivalent 与"等同、相同"沾边，读起来像在说"和大家想的一样"，很容易被语义直觉骗过去。
questions.fix: 背下这个句型：contrary to what many (might) assume / believe / expect。

questions.brief: not such a simple formula ≈ not as simple as
less stressed / less likely to quit 双词命中
rejected the long hours + took steps to adjust
a very privileged conversation ≈ privilege reserved for the better-off

questions.stem: Knowing one's emotional state is of utmost importance in deciding what changes to make for a better work-life balance.
questions.zh: 了解自己的情绪状态，对于决定要做哪些改变来改善工作与生活的平衡至关重要。
questions.quote: G) …“Awareness of your emotional state is essential in order to determine the changes you want to make in your work and in your life,” says Lupu.
questions.why: 三点同时落在 G 段同一句：Knowing one's emotional state ≈ Awareness of your emotional state；deciding what changes to make ≈ determine the changes you want to make；utmost importance ≈ essential。
questions.you: J 段讲的是"管理方被要求明确支持员工"，和"情绪状态"没有任何交集。你多半是被 J 段开头的 to ensure better work-life balance 吸引过去的——只匹配了一个主题词，没匹配命题内容。
questions.fix: 题干先划抽象名词（emotional state / changes），去原文找它们的同义替换；balance 这种全文出现 5 次的词，不能当定位词。

questions.brief: 女性 50% ＞ 男性 30%，resisting working long hours
will be in vain ≈ will be unsuccessful
dominated discussion ≈ main subject of discussion

questions.stem: You may not actually experience emotional wellbeing at home if you remain occupied with what happened at work.
questions.zh: 如果你脑子里还装着工作上的事，那么即使人在家里，你也可能并未真正体验到情绪上的安宁。
questions.quote: H) …If the underlying emotional sources of stress are still there, then the time you actually spend at home may not be enjoyable. “We come home and even though physically we are there, mentally we still may be processing things that happened at work. We're not present,” she says.
questions.why: remain occupied with what happened at work ≈ mentally processing things that happened at work；may not actually experience emotional wellbeing at home ≈ the time you actually spend at home may not be enjoyable。
questions.you: G 段的核心是"五步法任何人都能学"，讲的是方法；题干讲的是状态（人在家、心没回家）。40、44 两题都押 G，说明当时把 G 当成了"万金油段"。
questions.fix: 选完一段自检：题干里最不常见的那个词（occupied with / actually experience），段里必须有影子。

questions.stem: Some researchers suggest that work-life balance is not a goal to achieve, but a process for life to be adjusted promptly.
questions.zh: 一些研究者提出：工作与生活的平衡不是一个要达成的目标，而是一个需要及时调整的过程。
questions.quote: C) …Some researchers are now encouraging us to stop thinking about work-life balance as an achievement that you either hit or don't. Instead, they suggest it may be more of a lifelong process—a continuous, never-ending exercise that requires self-awareness and timely adjustments.
questions.why: not a goal to achieve ≈ stop thinking about it as an achievement；a process… adjusted promptly ≈ lifelong process… timely adjustments。两个短语级替换同时命中。
questions.you: E 段有 adjust 这个词，你就被它勾住了。但 E 段是"拒绝长时间工作的人的具体做法"，题干是"对平衡这个概念本身的重新定义"，层级完全不同。
questions.fix: 题干出现 is not A, but B 的定义型判断，答案段必有"否定 + 改称"结构（stop thinking… Instead… more of a…）。只出现单个动词的段落一律排除。

questions.brief: might be good for economic growth but is bad for people → 不明智
自然词汇每三个降到略多于一个 → 与自然脱节
right to grow 原词复现 + get back in touch with the soil
1649 年南英格兰 + 应对粮价 → 增加食物供给、改善城市景观

questions.stem: What can publicly accessible fruit and vegetable gardens do apart from their practical functions?
questions.zh: 除了实用功能之外，人人都能进的果蔬园还能带来什么？
questions.quote: …They can make unlovely spaces lovely, and marry use and beauty as well as help promote a sense of community.
questions.why: 题干 apart from their practical functions 对应的正是这句的"非实用"部分：美化环境 + a sense of community。D) Enhance people's community spirit 就是 promote a sense of community 的直译式改写。
questions.you: A) Raise people's environmental awareness 在文章里根本没有出现。它诱人是因为全文主题是"人与自然"，"环保意识"是最顺手的常识联想——你在用背景知识补原文没有的信息。
questions.fix: 选完回原文，把选项里每个实词圈一遍。圈不到就排除。"常识正确但原文没写"是最会骗人的一类选项。

questions.stem: What does the passage say about the engineering profession in the United States?
questions.zh: 文章关于美国的工程行业说了什么？
questions.quote: In 1970, the percentage of women majoring in engineering was less than 1%. In 1979, that number was 9%. … Today, only 21% of engineering majors are women, a number largely unchanged since 2000.
questions.why: B) It witnessed a significant increase in women engineers in the 1970s. 1% → 9%，九倍增长，且明确限定 1970s，与选项逐字对应。
questions.you: A) It has seen a change in attitude towards women engineers since 1979. 问题在 attitude（态度）：原文给的是人数比例（percentage / number），不是态度；而且 1979 年之后原文说的是"比例 2000 年以来基本没变"，恰恰是没怎么变。
questions.fix: 选项里出现 attitude / awareness / spirit / tendency 这类抽象心理词，先回原文找同一个抽象词，找不到就是让你用常识替原文做心理推断。

questions.brief: continuing to believe in myself + 不被重视 → 不失去自信
we don't truly belong / never quite one of the groups → 被排斥
more accepted mostly because there are just more of them

questions.stem: What can we conclude about many female engineers from the statement of a mechanical engineer?
questions.zh: 从一位机械工程师的话里，我们能得出关于许多女工程师的什么结论？
questions.quote: Many women engineers hailed the benefits of their chosen career. … A mechanical engineer said, “It will give you the flexibility to do almost anything. It is also satisfying to see the effects of what you have done.”
questions.why: A) They take great pride in their chosen career. 依据是 hailed the benefits of their chosen career ＋ satisfying to see the effects of what you have done——以自己选择的职业为荣、从中获得满足。
questions.you: D) They have proved capable of doing almost anything. 你把 “the flexibility to do almost anything”（这份职业自由度极高）读成了“她们已被证明什么都能做”。两处偷换：flexibility≠capable，主观感受≠客观能力评价。错误选项最爱这样：保留 almost anything 这种眼熟词，换掉关键名词。
questions.fix: 选项和原文长得像时逐词对：哪个词被换掉了？换掉后主语、性质、程度有没有变？变了就是错项。
